human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Operators still need a second model after imperfect runs to answer four questions: what did not complete, what evidence-backed root-cause class is visible, what is the current risk, and what should happen next. Ailuros already has canonical evidence/reporting surfaces. Add the smallest producer-neutral diagnosis projection over structured canonical evidence. It must distinguish process/execution failure, scope failure, validation failure or absence, and unproven completion without guessing vendor/API causes from logs or rewriting governance facts.
human_pressure.why_now: EverRun is beginning to emit richer runtime evidence; the next consumer-side value is turning those facts into a concise, deterministic operator diagnosis instead of requiring manual log archaeology.
do_not_misread: Diagnosis is not execution and must not edit packs, repositories or runtime state.
A root-cause class is evidence-backed classification, not speculative causal storytelling.
Ailuros must remain producer-neutral; EverRun is a reference producer, not a semantic branch.
Unknown evidence remains unknown and must not be promoted to a specific API/OS/OOM cause.
red_lines: No parsing of raw console prose to manufacture governance facts.
No automatic remediation or pack mutation.
No ACCEPT decision from diagnosis alone.
Do not change frozen regression ordering or core governance projection semantics.

machine_core.goal: Produce a deterministic operator-facing diagnosis from canonical structured run evidence with four bounded fields: incomplete work, root-cause class, current risk, and next action recommendation.
red_lines: Use canonical structured events/fields only for diagnosis decisions.
Do not infer rate limiting, OOM, network failure or vendor outage unless a canonical structured fact explicitly proves that class.
Do not convert missing validation or missing acceptance evidence into failed validation; preserve the distinction.
Do not recommend widening scope as a generic response to scope contamination.
invariants: The same canonical evidence yields the same diagnosis regardless of producer source label.
Diagnosis never overrides canonical lifecycle/outcome/governance facts.
Unknown or insufficient cause evidence yields an unknown/insufficient-evidence diagnosis rather than a guessed cause.
Recommendations are advisory and bounded to existing operator concepts such as retry, repair runtime/pack definition, confirm/reconcile, stop or human review.
Structural package validity and diagnosis are separate concerns.

observable_effect.assertion: An imperfect run produces a deterministic concise diagnosis covering incomplete work, evidence-backed root-cause class, risk, and next action without producer-specific branches or speculative log parsing.

proofs.assertion: A canonical executor/process-loss fact yields execution_runtime/process_supervision class and does not name an API/vendor cause when none is proven.
Canonical scope contamination yields scope_boundary class and recommends fixing attribution/pack scope evidence rather than blind coder retry.
A done lifecycle with missing accepted validation evidence is diagnosed as unproven completion, distinct from validation failure.
Changing manifest source metadata leaves the diagnosis unchanged.

failure_semantics: Malformed packages remain validator failures and are not diagnosed as runtime failures.
Contradictory canonical facts produce an explicit evidence inconsistency/unknown diagnosis rather than selecting the convenient fact.
Missing root-cause evidence keeps root cause unknown while still allowing risk/incomplete-work facts supported by evidence.
If no safe next action can be determined, recommend human_review/inspection rather than inventing a fix.

steps.title: Define a closed minimal diagnosis vocabulary
details: Keep root-cause classes small and operational: execution_runtime/process_supervision, scope_boundary, validation, unproven_completion, pack_definition, evidence_inconsistent, unknown.
Reuse existing action/status vocabulary where available instead of introducing a new policy language.
Define risk in a small closed form sufficient for operator display; avoid maturity scoring or multidimensional lenses.

steps.title: Project diagnosis from structured evidence
details: Read canonical execution/report/evidence structures already present in Ailuros.
Map only explicit structured facts to diagnosis classes.
Preserve evidence references/identifiers so each conclusion can be traced without copying raw logs.

steps.title: Render the four operator questions
details: Expose concise human-readable and deterministic machine-readable output for: incomplete, root cause, risk, next action.
Prefer extending the existing execution report/CLI surface rather than creating a new service.
Keep recommendation advisory; no write/action execution occurs here.

steps.title: Lock no-guess and source-neutral behavior
details: Test process loss with no vendor cause and prove the diagnosis stays generic/unknown at the sub-cause level.
Test scope, failed validation, missing validation/acceptance, and contradictory evidence separately.
Relabel source metadata and prove byte-equivalent machine diagnosis where generated timestamps are fixed.

acceptance: Canonical imperfect-run evidence yields the four bounded diagnosis fields.
Process loss does not get mislabeled as Volcengine/API/OOM without explicit evidence.
Scope failure, validation failure, and unproven completion remain distinct.
No repository/runtime mutation or automatic remediation is introduced.
Existing governance projection/regression behavior is unchanged.
Full tests, ruff and mypy pass.

must_check: Diagnosis uses structured canonical evidence only and is source-neutral.
The four output questions are concise and deterministic.
Unknown causes remain unknown instead of being guessed from vendor/log context.
Scope, validation and unproven completion semantics are not collapsed.
Recommendations do not execute changes or bypass governance gates.
Frozen projection/regression semantics are untouched and all validation passes.
reject_if: Any source == everrun semantic branch is introduced.
Free-form console/log parsing becomes authoritative diagnosis evidence.
Diagnosis can automatically edit a pack, widen scope or fabricate acceptance evidence.
A missing fact is reported as a passed or failed fact without evidence.
The implementation introduces a complex policy engine or multidimensional maturity model.
Forbidden files change or validation fails.
